## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive; confirmations: broad sector participation (9/11) alongside major-cap divergences in Technology (AAPL ABOVE TREND vs NVDA CORRECTION and GOOGL CORRECTION) and concentrated top gains in Tech. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology in Top 5).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy lead: XOM (1W: +3.81% | 1M: +6.05%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.81% | 1M: +3.82%) ABOVE TREND. Technology strong: NOW (1W: +18.67% | 1M: +3.16%) ABOVE TREND, CSCO (1W: +12.25% | 1M: +27.48%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +8.28% | 1M: +40.98%) ABOVE TREND. Financials participating but mixed: V (1W: +3.26% | 1M: +6.94%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +0.58% | 1M: -3.52%) RECOVERY.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Materials lag: FCX (1W: -9.37% | 1M: -9.92%) BELOW TREND, NEM (1W: -9.73% | 1M: -1.75%) BELOW TREND. Industrials weak: BA (1W: -7.65% | 1M: +1.39%) CORRECTION, ETN (1W: -6.70% | 1M: -7.07%) BELOW TREND. Communication shows large-cap weakness despite flat sector return—META (1W: -1.88% | 1M: -9.54%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -3.41% | 1M: +17.04%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: NOW (1W: +18.67% | 1M: +3.16%) ABOVE TREND, ACN (1W: +12.27% | 1M: -7.82%) RECOVERY, CSCO (1W: +12.25% | 1M: +27.48%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +10.07% | 1M: -19.92%) RECOVERY, TJX (1W: +8.64% | 1M: +0.30%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology), signalling concentrated short-term gains.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: APD (1W: -5.56% | 1M: -1.90%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -6.29% | 1M: +7.98%) CORRECTION, CRH (1W: -6.37% | 1M: -13.24%) BELOW TREND, DOW (1W: -6.62% | 1M: -5.32%) BELOW TREND, ETN (1W: -6.70% | 1M: -7.07%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Materials and Industrials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W momentum: NOW (1W: +18.67% | 1M: +3.16%) ABOVE TREND, ACN (1W: +12.27% | 1M: -7.82%) RECOVERY, CSCO (1W: +12.25% | 1M: +27.48%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +10.07% | 1M: -19.92%) RECOVERY, PANW (1W: +8.28% | 1M: +40.98%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence present (≥3 large names with 1W ≠ 1M), so treat momentum as tactical and watch for follow-through rather than broad conviction.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed but constructive in parts: AAPL (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +13.66%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +3.91% | 1M: -0.73%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: -1.05% | 1M: +11.80%) CORRECTION, GOOGL (1W: -3.41% | 1M: +17.04%) CORRECTION, META (1W: -1.88% | 1M: -9.54%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth supportive to the market (part of the 9/11 positive sectors) but leadership is uneven across mega-caps and software/security names.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials showing patchy strength: V (1W: +3.26% | 1M: +6.94%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +0.58% | 1M: -3.52%) RECOVERY, MA (1W: +1.51% | 1M: -2.60%) RECOVERY. Sector 1W positive and participating, but style is mixed and not a clear Value rotation yet.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare steady with pockets of strength: LLY (1W: +0.48% | 1M: +13.02%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -4.45% | 1M: +10.78%) CORRECTION, JNJ (1W: -0.48% | 1M: +1.40%) CORRECTION, PFE (1W: -0.65% | 1M: -4.01%) BELOW TREND. Sentiment-driven catalysts (MRK, ISRG) could drive dispersion within the sector.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Maintain neutral positioning and favor selective Energy and resilient Technology names while reducing exposure to Materials and some Industrials showing structural weakness. Given narrow top leadership and major divergence, prioritize tactical exposure and monitor earnings/news catalysts for confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: NOW (1W: +18.67% | 1M: +3.16%) ABOVE TREND, TJX (1W: +8.64% | 1M: +0.30%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +3.81% | 1M: +6.05%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: FCX (1W: -9.37% | 1M: -9.92%) BELOW TREND, NEM (1W: -9.73% | 1M: -1.75%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -1.88% | 1M: -9.54%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +4.07%) and pockets of Technology (1W: +3.24%) for follow-through on recent gains. BEARISH: Materials (1W: -4.55%) and Industrials (1W: -1.00%) where downside pressure and negative sentiment are concentrated.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch NVDA (1W: -1.05% | 1M: +11.80%) CORRECTION — a sustained 1W reversal back above trend would signal renewed participation. Monitor AAPL (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +13.66%) ABOVE TREND for continuation on AI/transition headlines. Track TJX (1W: +8.64% | 1M: +0.30%) ABOVE TREND for guidance confirmation after bullish FY update.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
TJX (+80): TJX (1W: +8.64% | 1M: +0.30%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment (+80) confirms price strength and FY guidance follow-through. SHOP (+55): SHOP (1W: +10.07% | 1M: -19.92%) RECOVERY — bullish headlines coincide with strong 1W momentum but 1M remains weak (partial confirmation). AAPL (+50): AAPL (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +13.66%) ABOVE TREND — positive AI/CEO headlines align with broader accumulation.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
CRM (-50): CRM (1W: +8.60% | 1M: -3.75%) RECOVERY — negative analyst note but price is rallying, creating a divergence to watch. DOW (-45): DOW (1W: -6.62% | 1M: -5.32%) BELOW TREND — bearish headlines confirm price weakness. NEE (-45): NEE (1W: -6.94% | 1M: -2.57%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price confirm deterioration.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership and Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive; Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology in Top 5). NOW (1W: +18.67% | 1M: +3.16%) ABOVE TREND, CSCO (1W: +12.25% | 1M: +27.48%) ABOVE TREND and XOM (1W: +3.81% | 1M: +6.05%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is major-cap divergence—AAPL ABOVE TREND versus NVDA (1W: -1.05% | 1M: +11.80%) CORRECTION and CRM negative news (-50) while in RECOVERY — watch for trend breaks and sentiment follow-through.
